name: Launching Crossbow Flurry
body:
Your expertise with the launching crossbow allows you to rain devastation on others.

Prerequisite(s): Proficiency with alchemical launching crossbow, multibomb class feature.

Benefit(s): You treat attacks with the alchemical launching crossbow as normal attacks with bombs, allowing you to load the additional bomb(s) you can throw with the multi bomb or flurry bomb class feature into your alchemical launching crossbow and fire it during the same attack action.

Special: If you have an ability which would increase the range increment of your bombs, you can also have it increase the range increment of your alchemical launching crossbow.
